notes: CHK-012 has no disable iff and its antecedent is reset asserted. It also checks the CHK-017 constants: param=0, size=2'b10, source=PARA_SRC_ID, mask=4'hF, user=0. CHK-013 uses a helper register, prev_rst_n, that holds the reset level from the previous edge. With i_rst_n_core=1 at E (the disable iff handles this), prev_rst_n=1 means reset was also released at E-1. I did not compile either check in Verilator.
